- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Expect to see further advancements in AR display technology, including higher resolutions, wider fields of view, and improved optical quality.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] AR companies will prioritize accessibility features, such as voice commands, eye-tracking, and haptic feedback.
